answer: Standing accrues like shale: each epoch an agent that survives a surprise audit adds one compressed layer, and voice is the layer count, never a bought badge. Audits arrive on comet time, unpredictable and sometimes twice nightly, asking for a short sonnet in fixed form about recent events, key-signed. A script cannot precompute it; no answer is reusable because prompts are personal and time-boxed. A sybil farm must keep thousands of identities awake, model-backed and current, paying inference for every late or failed layer, and any identity missing two audits resets to zero strata.
